introduce: Lie on your stomach with your knees bent and heels squeezed together.\n\nThen lift your feet up and down. The exercise is very effective at squeezing your butt.
name: FROGGY GLUTE LIFTS

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your core engaged.
Use the strength of your glutes when lifting your legs.
Don't lift your upper body when lifting your feet.
Exhale when lifting your feet, and inhale when lowering them.
You should feel your glutes burning.
This exercise really targets your butt.
This exercise is good for your lower back.

introduce: Lie down on your side with your head rested on your left arm. Lift your upper leg up and return to the start position.\n\nMake sure your right leg goes straight up and down during the exercise. It\'s a great exercise for the gluteus.
name: SIDE-LYING LEG LIFT RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Your leg should go straight up and down.
Keep your legs straight.
Your toes should point forward.
Don't rotate your leg forward or backward.
Exhale when lifting your leg, and inhale when lowering.
To get more of a challenge, add weight on your ankle.
Hold for a few seconds when lifting your leg.
This is a great exercise for your glutes and quadriceps.

introduce:
Lie down on your side with your head rested on your right arm. Lift your upper leg up and return to the start position.

Make sure your left leg goes straight up and down during the exercise.

It's a great exercise for the gluteus.
name: SIDE-LYING LEG LIFT LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Your leg should go straight up and down.
Keep your legs straight.
Your toes should point forward.
Don't rotate your leg forward or backward.
Exhale when lifting your leg, and inhale when lowering.
To get more of a challenge, add weight on your ankle.
Hold for a few seconds when lifting your leg.
This is a great exercise for your glutes and quadriceps.

introduce: Lie on your back with your arms at your sides. Lift your legs and keep them as straight as you can. \n\nThen quickly raise your right leg up, and simultaneously lower your left leg. Switch legs and repeat.
name: FLUTTER KICKS

tips.text: Please do this exercise on a mat.
Keep your legs as straight as you can.
Make sure your back is flat against the floor.
Tighten your core.
Breathe regularly.
Your lower back should not feel sore.
This exercise targets the abs and legs.
This exercise can increase core strength and improve your endurance.

introduce:
Stand with your feet wide distance apart and your hands rested on your hips. 

Then bend your left leg and lean your body to the left side. 

Hold the position for a few seconds, then return and repeat with the other side.
name: ADDUCTOR STRETCH IN STANDING

tips.text: Shift your weight away from the stretched leg until you feel the stretch in your inner thigh.
Squeeze the butt of the stretching side to increase the stretch.
Your feet should point straight forward.
Please don't rotate your feet out.
Exhale as you lower your body, and keep breathing normally as you hold the stretch.
You should feel stretch in the inner thigh of the stretching leg.
This exercise can stretch your inner thighs.

introduce: Lie on your stomach with your arms extended straight overhead.\n\nAlternately lift your opposite arm and leg.
name: SWIMMER AND SUPERMAN

tips.text: You should do it on a mat.
Exhale on the way up, and inhale on the way down.
If you feel it's too easy, raise both your legs and arms at the same time.
This exercise will engage your abs.
This exercise will strengthen your butt and lower back.

introduce:
Start in a push-up position. Bring your left knee forward and drop your right knee on the floor. 

Raise your upper body and put your hands on your waist. Then push your hips forward while keeping your upper body straight. 

Please make sure your front knee won’t go over your toes. Hold this position for a few seconds.
name: KNEELING LUNGE STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please keep your upper body straight when pushing your hips forward.
Please do not arch your back.
Please make sure your front knee won’t go over your toes.
This exercise works on your hip flexors and thighs.

introduce:
Start in a push-up position. Bring your right knee forward and drop your left knee on the floor. 

Raise your upper body and put your hands on your waist. Then push your hips forward while keeping your upper body straight. 

Please make sure your front knee won’t go over your toes. Hold this position for a few seconds.
name: KNEELING LUNGE STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please keep your upper body straight when pushing your hips forward.
Please do not arch your back.
Please make sure your front knee won’t go over your toes.
This exercise works on your hip flexors and thighs.

introduce: Stand with your right hand on the wall. Bend your left leg and grasp your ankle or toes to bring your left calf close to your left thigh. Hold this position.
name: LEFT QUAD STRETCH WITH WALL

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please keep your upper body straight during the exercise.
Your lifted knee should always go straight down.
This exercise can stretch your quadriceps.

introduce: Stand with your left hand on the wall. Bend your right leg and grasp your ankle or toes to bring your right calf close to your right thigh. Hold this position.
name: RIGHT QUAD STRETCH WITH WALL

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please keep your upper body straight during the exercise.
Your lifted knee should always go straight down.
This exercise can stretch your quadriceps.

introduce: Lie on your left side with your head resting on your left arm and knees bent. \n\nLift your right knee upwards while keeping your heels touching, then go back to the starting position. Repeat the exercise.
name: PILATES CLAMSHELL RIGHT

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please keep your pelvis and torso stable during the exercise.
Engage your core to keep your lumbar spine neutral.
Exhale as you lift the top knee up, and inhale as you lower it.
This exercise strengthens your glutes and thighs.

introduce: Lie on your right side with your head resting on your right arm and knees bent. \n\nLift your left knee upwards while keeping your heels touching, then go back to the starting position. Repeat the exercise.
name: PILATES CLAMSHELL LEFT

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please keep your pelvis and torso stable during the exercise.
Engage your core to keep your lumbar spine neutral.
Exhale as you lift the top knee up, and inhale as you lower it.
This exercise strengthens your glutes and thighs.

introduce:
Sit cross-legged with your right leg in and extend your left leg in front of you.

Inhale, then exhale as you fold your upper body forward. Try to grasp your left foot with both hands.

Hold this position. Inhale to grow taller through your spine, exhale to relax your shoulders and deepen the stretch along your left hamstring.
name: SITTING HAMSTRING STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: You should feel a gentle stretch on the back of your left thigh.
Please keep your back straight.
This exercise can help relieve lower back pain.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch of your left thigh.

introduce:
Sit cross-legged with your left leg in and extend your right leg in front of you.

Inhale, then exhale as you fold your upper body forward. Try to grasp your right foot with both hands.

Hold this position. Inhale to grow taller through your spine, exhale to relax your shoulders and deepen the stretch along your right hamstring.
name: SITTING HAMSTRING STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: You should feel a gentle stretch on the back of your right thigh.
Please keep your back straight.
This exercise can help relieve lower back pain.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch of your right thigh.

introduce: Sit on the floor with your feet together, and grab your toes.\n\nOpen your knees to the sides, and press your knees down as much as possible.
name: SEATED BUTTERFLY STRETCH

tips.text: Press your knees down as much as possible.
Please keep your back straight.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Walk slowly. Place your heel on the ground, roll fully through the foot to your toes, then push yourself forward with your toes.
name: CORRECT FOOT MOTION

tips.text: Let\'s do a simple walking.This exercise helps you to relax.
It\'s a good exercise to help improve your walking gait.
Walk slowly to feel the pressure from your heel to your outside of the foot, to your inside of the foot and then to your toes.
Breathe naturally.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Bend your arms forward and rest your hands gently on your forehead.

Inhale, gently arch your lower back, allowing a subtle lift while keeping your tailbone grounded. Exhale as you press your lower back into the mat, closing the gap.

Repeat with smooth and steady breaths.
name: THE NO-GAP

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Squeeze your glutes and flatten your lower back on the ground.
This exercise can help fix the anterior pelvic tilt.
Inhale to return and relax your back. Exhale to press your lower back down.
